privacyModules.title: Data Collection
privacyModules.summary: Understanding the specific digital footprints we analyze.
privacyModules.content: We collect information you provide directly to us (names, emails, company data) and automated usage metrics through our infrastructure to optimize your experience.

privacyModules.title: Data Usage
privacyModules.summary: How your information fuels business intelligence.
privacyModules.content: Your data is strictly used to provide, maintain, and improve our services, develop new features, and protect Auxinzio and our users from fraudulent activity.

privacyModules.title: Sharing Protocols
privacyModules.summary: Our standards for third-party ecosystem integration.
privacyModules.content: We do not sell your personal data. We only share information with trusted service providers who adhere to our strict privacy standards and legal requirements.

expandedSections.title: Infrastructural Security
expandedSections.content: Auxinzio employs military-grade encryption and architectural-level security measures to protect your data. Our infrastructure is audited regularly to ensure compliance with global security standards.

expandedSections.title: Constitutional Rights
expandedSections.content: You retain full sovereignty over your data. This includes the right to access, rectify, or request the erasure of your personal information from our active databases at any time.

expandedSections.title: Cookie Taxonomy
expandedSections.content: We use advanced tracking tokens (cookies) to maintain your session state and understand site interaction. You can manage these preferences through your architectural dashboard.
